sources.summary: Designer Lee Broom has created an "atmospheric environment" in his Shoreditch showroom with The Chant Chambers, an installation showcasing his glass-block Chant lighting collection at London Design Festival. The Chant Chambers displays the modular light in a variety of forms – as a portable lamp, wall lamp, linear pendants and oversized chandeliers.
